definitions.explanation: A light, porous volcanic rock full of tiny air holes, so light that it can float on water. Used to scrub calluses off skin, clean rough surfaces, and improve drainage in potted plants.

examples.japanese: {軽石|かるいし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧かかと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こする。
examples.english: I scrub my heels with a pumice stone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軽石|かるいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of pumice had washed up on the beach near the volcano.

notes:
A porous volcanic rock light enough to float. Named from ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ (light) + ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽石|かるいし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧こする: to scrub with a pumice stone
- {軽石|かるいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}く→浮く：00413_uku⟧: pumice floats
- {軽石|かるいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧: a layer of pumice

TYPICAL USES:
- removing calluses and rough skin from feet
- scouring stubborn grime
- lightening and aerating garden soil
